purpose: Candidate localization research for the English 'Gefstimate' wordplay. Advisory only; never use this file as the language-support registry.

policy.note: A pun is worth shipping only when a local word meaning estimate remains immediately recognizable after Gef replaces or joins its opening sound. Technical loanwords can be valid yet wrong for friendly consumer UI.

strong_candidates.note: English portmanteau; product owner's proposed term.
Common noun for an approximate estimate.
Romansh government usage shows stimaziun for estimation.
Haitian Creole government usage uses estimasyon.

register_sensitive_candidates.note: Recognized in statistical terminology; everyday estimate may instead be càlcul/pressupost.
Danish estimat exists, especially mathematical/technical; everyday estimate often skøn/vurdering.
Recognized Basque form in statistical/estimation contexts; zenbatespen is also standard and may be more idiomatic.
Technical/statistical loan form exists; everyday estimate is more often arvio.
Bokmål recognizes estimat, though anslag/overslag are also common.
Statistical/technical estimat exists; everyday estimate is usually skattning/uppskattning.

literal_default_note: These languages were checked in the first-pass 104-language sweep and no sufficiently obvious broadly natural estim-/stima- portmanteau was identified. Localize the semantic phrase 'Gef estimate' normally. A native reviewer may later promote a genuinely good local joke.

src_en.note: English source word; Gefstimate is first-party wordplay.

src_es.note: Spanish uses estimación / estimar for estimate.

src_pt.note: Portuguese estimativa is an estimate/approximate calculation.

src_gl.note: Galician estimar includes approximate calculation; dictionary neighborhood includes estimación.

src_stats.note: International Statistical Institute multilingual glossary includes estimate terminology for Catalan, Romanian, Danish, Norwegian, Swedish, Finnish, Basque and others.

src_id.note: KBBI mirror records Indonesian estimasi as perkiraan/penilaian.

src_rm.note: Official Grisons Romansh text uses stimaziun/stimaziuns.

src_ht.note: US Census Haitian Creole text uses estimasyon.

src_nn.note: Official Nynorsk dictionary entry for estimat.
